remainingLimits: Later action relies substantially on the named secondary guides, not primary chapters read continuously.
Some genuine quotations embedded in guides supply a narrow hinge or a reaction, not the whole surrounding event. Independent evidence grading below preserves that distinction.
No continuous complete novel or official Russian translation claim; no real-world historical, zoological, clinical or scientific validation is inferred from fiction.

narrativeAssessment.reason: Characters perform concrete actions with consequences: misplaced shoes, brutal absurd camp routine, false KB find, reciprocal lessons, fights, search, sick friend carried, night standoff, name/records/alibi and family reunion. Recurring shoes, names, song, onions and peaches connect the three periods. Humor and danger survive condensation; story events carry the ethical meaning. No management/moral replacement, fabricated dialogue or quota padding found.

routes.essential: Coherent invitation, injustice/camp, family thread, discovery, friendship and search, stopping before reunion or solutions.
routes.core: Adds bullying, repeated-name joke, outlaw, letters, venom/water episode, lipstick hypothesis, Sam/Katherine/Trout and thumb clue; stops at the same unresolved search.
routes.deep: Completes both past lines and present action with correctly supported cause/order, culminating in legal and family answers.

narrativeAssessment.bilingualAssessment: All 39 pairs preserve names, relationships, causes, certainty and spoiler levels. RU is this condensation's rendering, not claimed to be an official published translation.
narrativeAssessment.ancestryAndAmbiguity: Elya's great-great-grandson and Madame Zeroni's great-great-great-grandson are distinguished from robbed great-grandfather Stanley I. Warden is Trout's granddaughter. Song/water/carrying parallel and invention timing remain story events; mother's disbelief prevents certainty about a literal curse mechanism.
narrativeAssessment.ethicsAndWorldClaims: The white teacher/Black man's kiss, town violence, sheriff and murder remain causally explicit without a modern lecture. Onions/lizards/rain remain within fiction; Zero's stomach pain is not diagnosed.

spoilerAssessment.scope: Full static review of the effective reader's scripts and all cover/final/global Sources/method copy, alongside existing current-hash behavior receipts. No fresh browser run.
spoilerAssessment.contentBoundary: All decisive historical outcomes, reunion, explicit ancestry, theft answer, treasure/name, legal release and final family outcomes are level 3. Shallow clues such as KB and Hector Zeroni's name are not presented as solved ancestry.
spoilerAssessment.coverFinalSourcesMethod: Spoiler-safe in both languages; external sources carry explicit spoiler notices. Shared final discloses navigation only.
spoilerAssessment.contentsAndRail: safeTitle masks every level-3 title whenever consent is absent or depth is not Deep. Both contents surfaces use it.
spoilerAssessment.firstLateAccess: setMode, goToId and goToPosition gate Deep actions with localized explicit modal consent; contents closes before the consent modal opens.
spoilerAssessment.cancelEscape: Both clear pending action without changing position, mode or saved lastScreen. No late content is rendered before acceptance.
spoilerAssessment.reloadDowngrade: Consent is a non-persisted local variable. Saved Deep mode is downgraded before initial render; any shallower setMode revokes consent.
spoilerAssessment.continue: renderCover uses generic Deep spoiler wording instead of a saved late title; accepted Continue uses the exact saved ID, and rejected Continue preserves it.
